page_description: Zones are the countries you ship to; each offers its options at checkout.
zones_empty_description: Carts to a country outside every zone can't choose shipping, so physical products can't be checked out there.
zone_countries_description: Two-letter codes, separated by commas. A country is in one zone at most.
zone_no_options: No options yet: carts here can't choose shipping.
option_backup_description: Offered only when every rate app option of this zone fails, so an outage doesn't stop sales.
option_delivery_invalid: Enter delivery days as whole numbers, like 2 and 4.
rate_kind_free_over_description: A price, free from a subtotal.
rate_kind_provider_description: Quoted live by a rate app.
rate_error_price: Enter prices as numbers, like 4.90 or 0.
rate_error_provider: Choose a rate app and the service it quotes.
rate_error_free_over: Enter the price and the amount it's free from, like 4.90 and 50.
rate_error_weight_limit: Enter each tier's limit in whole grams, like 1000.
rate_error_subtotal_limit: Enter each tier's limit as an amount, like 50.
rate_summary_weight_tiers: {count, plural, one {# weight tier} other {# weight tiers}} ({currencies})
rate_summary_subtotal_tiers: {count, plural, one {# subtotal tier} other {# subtotal tiers}} ({currencies})
rate_service_description: The code the app quotes it under.
apps_description: Services that quote live prices: carriers, or your own code in any language.
apps_empty: None yet. Built-in rates need no app.
app_rotate_warning: The current secret stops working at once.
app_new_secret_tooltip: New secret: the current one stops working at once.
app_timeout_invalid: Enter the timeout in milliseconds, like 3000.
app_dialog_subtitle: Hypha POSTs each rate request to the callback, signed with the app's secret: a new app's is shown next.
app_key_description: How options name it: app_ and lowercase letters, digits and _. Can't change later. An existing app's key adds rates to that app.
app_timeout_description: Slower answers count as failures, and the zone's backup options show.
app_secret_subtitle: Copy it now: it isn't shown again. The app checks the Hypha-Signature header with it.
